scores.interpretation: 70 percent says most of the required machinery exists. 39 percent says most of it has never been observed working against anything real. For a system that spends customer money irreversibly, the second number governs.
scores.calculation: sum(weight * category_pct) over the eight categories; weights unmodified from the brief; no renormalization applied

hard_gate_verdict.rationale: No order this platform has ever produced has reached any exchange, including a sandbox. The sole venue-side duplicate-order defence is unverified. Daily-loss and drawdown limits are not enforced at the order gateway. Authoritative equity is never reconciled against the venue. Restart recovery does not rediscover resting orders. Health checks cannot drain a dependency-broken task. There is no alerting and no proven restore. No test gate stands between a push to main and production.
hard_gate_verdict.note: A high average must not conceal a critical safety blocker. Execution integrity scores 88 percent implementation, and the single confirmed defect within it (unverified clientOrderId mapping) is sufficient on its own to double a customer position. That is why the hard gate is a separate verdict from the percentages.
